data: Definitely worth the money 10/10 would recommend :))
This is a really fun and awesome game with lots of content and in my oppinion definitely worth the money
10/10 Can't wait for more updates and extras
Very fun and relaxing, great game with fun graphics
Love the relaxing and satisfying gameplay
This game has so many bugs that makes it unplayable
This game is not worth your time and money, and you are better off buying the second one instead
There just isn't any content to justify the price
Unfortunately it is pretty slow and has bugs that eventually got harder and harder to overlook
Negative reviews in relation to this are false and not a bug
Honestly, I never expected cleaning dirty houses and fixing broken furniture to be this satisfying
I won't be buying any of the dlc
These are known issues I've seen and yet they're already putting out DLC
This should be straight up illegal for a game I already purchased at full price,
this game gets repetitive at one point,
I love this game. It's simple, it's calming, it's easy. That's kinda it. I like the bunkers.

I like it a lot. The new lawn mower is about as irritating to operate as the weed eater is. But hopefully that will get better with time. It's crazy that neither the weed eater nor the lawnmower can be operated in a straight line unless you have nothing to mow in that line. Then there are the new in ground pools that I do love. But there is no way to back away far enough to see where exactly you are putting it. The other still crazy is that no matter what you do, removing the old concrete walk path to the front door, always results in improper replacement alignment. Even if you remove porch tile, don't expect to be able to put every new piece back the way it was. For instance, if you have an eaves drain that you removed tile from under. You can't put a new one back into it's place. Crazy, I tell you. At least in real renovations we can cut pieces to fit. But regardless, it is a fun time passer and somewhat unnerving. The money making tasks are fun and so is renovating and decorating. I do love it, crazy and all.

There's something weirdly therapeutic about cleaning, painting, renovating.. the whole shebang! Didn't have any expectations going into this game, but after many hours (and all jobs completed) I can honestly say this truly has been so calming yet also strangely addictive to play thus far! Definitely recommend it to anyone still hesitating to get it, especially during a sale! (^-^)

Great game ! I hope they keep expanding the game and adding content monthly please ! This game is a great start to somethng amazing and I can only hope it get bettter ! I do think it needs a more of a campaign mode where you can work on goals on each house and why cant we alter the house structure or work on the outside of the houses ?

I think this game is pretty addicting and fun. The only part that i dislike is the lack of content. You blow through jobs pretty quickly and have to wait for the next update or you can do them again. Other then that i think this game is great.

i personally always loved decorating/building houses so this game was literally perfect for me! the graphics are amazing and i cant wait for house flipper 2!! i love how there is an option to decorate a house however you want, not just having to follow the rules :> anyways, would recommend <3

Why is this game so addictive? I spent way too long arranging food items on a shelf in a bunker despite the irrelevance to the goals in the game, because I just couldn't help myself.

Must. Turn. Chaos. Into. Order.

Oh, and make it look noice, too.
Not nearly enough content as it is. I'm afraid they're going to make upcoming DLC paid too as if the base game is even remotely worth the pricetag.

Look, there's no game here ok? At first it seems like it because you buy a house, fix it up, then sell it for a bit of profit. But at the end of the day the game is just about clicking and seeing something dirty turn clean. It's a brainless dopamine hit, and that's it. And I highly recommend it.

This is more of a cautionary no - its good when its on dirt cheap discount but not full price.
There are SO many bugs. Most are small/visual and not intrusive, but others are infuriating. 
I have been attempting to sell a house to every buyer and even with a PERFECT match, I can't get the landlord to win an auction. Clicking on his profile even shows a higher bid! But the game tells me to waste hours of work selling to people I've already cleared :/
The developers clearly don't really want to come back and fix this up so play at your own risk.

Love it. The game is relaxing, background music reminds me of early Sims quite a bit - comforting, not distracting.

The tasks eventually might start feeling repetative, but just like any sandbox-y game - you make your own game as you play. And I actually enjoy these simple tasks and being able to add my own twist to solutions. Definitely recommend!

Not being able to cut down my own grass without DLC is not cool. This is some next level ragebait to annoy players who doesn't have the Gardening DLC. At least you can customize the inside of your starter house or switch it to a different one.

I love this game! It's very fun and addicting especially if you like simulators or even designing your own houses on The Sims. My only complaint is there are a lot of bugs and glitches to be fixed. Also I hope they add more to do in the future that would be nice.
Easily my favourite game. Highly recommend. Great graphics, controls, and the dlcs are so affordable when on sale. Switched from the sims 4 to this and haven't regretted once.
It has its bugs and disadvantages, but I didn't install and buy all the DLC because I wanted another Sims game. I've always loved House Flipper.

Love Love Love this game... Takes you away from reality as you design dream homes and gardens!
Has dedicated quests and free design so you can jump back and forth depending on your tastes.
Great when you don't want to think to hard about things and want to tune out and create something pretty.
Tonnes of different design elements. Constantly getting DLC and Updates to help with any bugs that may be of issue.
Dev's really listening to what people want to see, makes this a fun game for all ages.
Okay for Adults or Children to play.
With so much new and FREE content being added regularly and new DLC's and the Workshop, you can't get bored.

This game is really cool & I can't wait to see how it will progress to make game play even more exciting. I do think this game could benefit from a few things.

First, I wish there was an "undo" button. So many times I accidentally do something (break a wall, tile a wall, etc.) & want to undo it.

Speaking of walls, I also would love it if wall building could be an easier process. I recognize that this game is meant to feel like you're actually flipping houses, but things like painting & demolishing walls get easier as you gain more experience, so why shouldn't building them?

Also, the game allows you to delete & replace the doors in the houses, but what about those windows? They are all the same & I wish there were alternative windows that fit a more modern aesthetic (as there are modern door options). It would be amazing if the windows & front & back door were movable as well.

There's probably a lot more I forgot to mention, but these are a few things that came to mind while playing House Flipper.

This game is perfect to kick back, relaxed, put on a podcast or music in the background and relax.

You can either buy houses, renovate them however you see fit and then sell them or take jobs where people have specific wishes for the house. Both are fun in their own way.

The DLC are great and I'd reccomend them but not at full price. I get them all 5-6€ each and felt this was a good deal for the amount of content they offer.

This game is addicting! Love to do the redecorating and changing the walls and so on. The music is relaxing and I can go off into my own "flipper" world for a while. For the money, this game has a lot. However, I wish I could do the yard too. Put out plants, pull weeds, cut the grass, it would all be good. Also, I wish I could add on rooms, move pipes if necessary, do more major reno work. I also wish I could use some of the furniture and fixtures I see when I go into homes. So much is lovely, but frustratingly unavailable to use. The same is true of paint colors. Again,, for the money this game has a lot. I would pay for DLC to have more! Keep it up, Empyrean, you've just begun!

It makes me wanna clean my own room. Gives great joy to restore the destructed house to welll designed and clean home. It gets easier to do the restorations by level ups. Only bad side of the game is, it is single player. I would like to play this with my friends as coop. Still it is a great game specially for the people who have obsessive compulsive disorder. Thumbs up!
I love this game, however my office I poured hours into was reset after finishing a job, so I don't really have much motivation to play anymore. Please address this glitch.
it's very fun, and is a good game for when you are bored. i recommend this game for all people who like cleaning and need something to play.
It's fun to customize the homes that I buy to resell and the little jobs to make money for flipping homes are fun to zone out to after a long day or week.
It's fun to get back into the game again after a long time. I am going to finish it before tackling the Dining Out DLC. I'll post about that when I get to it.
This game is super addictive, I've had a lot of fun flipping houses! You have a lot of freedom in the game in what you want to do, so I think they've done a great job

A word of warning for those who suffer from migraines or epilepsy or general motion sickness - don't purchase this game if you do. I had an episode that at first I thought was a fluke, but when I played it again the same thing happened - immediate dizziness and nausea. The movement is just too fast and I had everything set to slow movement. Besides that hiccup some things that I dislike about games are the lack of instructions. House Flipper has no instructions on how to use it or what you are supposed to do next. I want to go in and clean up the shed I live in by getting rid of the ratty furniture, but for some reason you can't do that. So nothing every happened. I am going to attempt to play this one more time and if I still have another bout of dizziness and nausea I am never playing it again.

This is going to be a qualified recommendation. A friend gifted to this to me recently, and I have had a lot of fun getting into it so far. There are bugs that Google searches indicate have been around for awhile (such as mounted showers and sinks becoming unrecognized by the game). There is no way to remove concrete slabs once placed outside, and tricks to resolve this have apparently been patched out of the game. Simple things such as cutting the grass are not possible without purchasing DLC. It is implausible that someone would refurbish a house to flip but do no yard work whatsoever.

......
fantastic game!! hella lot of room for growth!! :) <3

Fun to paint a room and not worry about floors or painting outside the line. Loved all the tidy up jobs and renovation. I wish the mower had come in the base game. Selling houses with prairie grass was silly

I am loving playing this game. You are the jack-of-all-trades. You renovate, decorate, demolish, re-model and build. It is a great game if you love interior design and decorating. There is lots of dlc, some bought and some free. It supports ultra wide screens and I have experienced no crashes in my game. There is the odd bug here or there but nothing game breaking.

* Update after pet dlc: Still loving it and many, many more hours poured into this game!

Do yourself a favour and check out the workshop for this game too. Lots of items and great content. And do not limit yourself to houses, try out cafe's, restaurants and retail. The templates for the most part do cater to houses/apartments but with the workshop you can think outside the box. ✨

got to say i love this game i only have like 20hours on steam as before i bought it i had torrent it but i loved it so much i had to buy it and support the creators i cant wait till the game gets more updates dlcs and fixes i hope the game becomes abit more freeing and i hope really hope they add more houses you can buy. devs keep the updates coming and great job
awesome game. played for almost 11 hours straight when i first got it. really fun.

House Flipper is the construction mode-only that Sims missed so much. It's fun and peaceful, some missions before you can do kinda whatev you wish are sometimes odd and i wonder who did think about that in the dev team.

They also have an odd about stealing radiators.

So I was at the house with the bunker beneath it. Fixed it up completely and sold it for $213,000~. As soon as it sold, my game froze then crashed. I booted the game backup to find out that my progress got reset back to 0%. Kinda mad about but hey.. yeah, fun game!!
As someone who likes chill games, this game is great for me. I love how the developers listen to people's ideas and then add them to the game over time. It's just gotten better and better!
Hands down my favourite game. With the Steam Workshop, this game is 10 times better, and the jobs are actually fun unlike other games.
Always fun to flip houses and sell. So relaxing to focus in game and forget what is going on around you.

I am deeply in love with this game, if there was the option to marry it then we would already be engaged. I got the pet DLC as a impulsive buy and honestly it is amazing, it suprised me how much was put into it (the map option, voice acting, story). When ever Im super bored i just put a video on and play this and i can spend hours just fixing up houses. I do wish there were more "quests" in the main game as im not to into fixing up a house to sell to someone but it took me 10-20 hours to do all the "quests" so I cant complain.
I love House Flipper! I first tried it with xbox live and fell in love! My brother was able to find it on here (steam) and got it for me for my birthday! It is one of my most favorite games!
I loved how you can clean and renovate many various homes to your liking. This is a game that i've really enjoyed and recommend to anyone who likes to have fun renovating!

A Really Great Game so far, but there are some points for criticism.

At first there is the Music. it's not really bad but some of the themes give me the creeps! Some music-tracks are scary AF and needs to be reworked.

second: the major lack of furniture! i mean come on - ONE Shower-design you can use? while there are other designs in a couple of houses, why don't include them to the shop to have some more variations?

third: unremovable/uncreateable slots for Sink, Bathtub, Toilet and Shower - please - i beg you - make them move-able!

My first experience of this game was on PS4 as it was free with PS+ and I remember thinking to myself... "this would be easier with a mouse".. As soon as I got some birthday money I bought it and spend 3+hours playing straight away. It's such a satisfying game. :)

Gameplay loop is pretty bland as far as an interior design sim goes- its interest in its pseudo-realism has led to poorly aged graphics, awful UX flows and writing, and a redundant gameplay loop. While it was interesting at first, and the game always going on sale was enticing, House Flipper does indeed deliver on the fantasy of landlord special-ing your way through your community, but it's just a time waster with ugly, muddy visuals and a huge lack of variety. Does it need to be The Sims 4 or Animal Crossing ? No, definitely not, but this game is so averse to charm that I wonder if I actually like simulation games.

With unclear goals per buyer, frustrating UX to purchase things on the tablet, and finicky controls when placing things around the house, this is undoubtedly a subpar video game. And the final nail in the coffin for me was the Chinese buyer, Chang Choi, whose primary goal in a home is to have a desk and bookshelf in his bedroom so he can study. I don't think I can like this game even a little bit.

This game has, overall, been very good, although there are some aspects/bugs that could be improved upon.
That was, until the most recent update.
Now, if I want to place something higher up, e.g. a glass on a shelf higher than head height, and try to jump onto a chair to reach, I end up falling through the ground, then re-appearing in the sky and landing at the gate!!
It now rains indoors - even with a roof firmly attached.
Jumping forward onto something clips you through the walls - I actually got stuck inside a staircase!
More and more items are 'sinking into' surfaces instead of sitting on top of them.
Whilst this was mildly amusing at first, it is making the game unplayable.
I cannot in good conscience recommend this game in it's current state.
its a very chill game and relaxing even for people who love high speed games

throughly enjoying this. Super relaxing, and the newer areas of the game are interesting, as you climb the ladder with clients as if an actual home designer hired. Prompts within the game are not always intuitive, but its not bad.

This game replicates some of the best aspects of Minecraft and The Sims for me despite being quite a different game to both overall. It's so satisfying to take a filthy wreck of a house with an awkward floorplan and turn it into something pristine and liveable. A very comfortable and peaceful game.
its a fun no stress game, especially if you like decorating rooms, you get more items as you advance

This game feeds my OCD like nothing else, and I love it! After playing this game (twice) I ended up actually renovating my house myself. Pull up the old dingy carpet in my room and put in walnut hardwood floors, no crew or assistance? Indeed, this is what happens when quirky OCD people play games made by equally as quirky OCD people. Repainted my walls, installed new curtains, and I gotta say, that method for using a broom on your ceiling actually works! Don't use vaccumes on roaches though, or broken glass. That one's not such a good idea. The socket repairs are also pretty accurate, except IRL there's five wires, not three (two of each hot and cold and one ground wire). Overall, I've played plenty of games, and somehow this has quickly become one of my absolute favorites. Highly recommended, especially for anyone artistic or who enjoys organization as I do!

I loved how we could decorate the house and buy the things by ourselves and it didn't need a specific order to do so. I also loved how we could buy our own house and it also teaches you how to budget. This is a great game if you want to do something like this in the future because it helps you practice. Believe me that 30 dollars was worth it. I have been playing for hours non stop for days and my office/ house looks so much better then my real life house. I have also realised that this game has motivated me to do more chores and re-decorate my house and my house has never looked so fresh and clean. Its so satisfying and I hope you will consider buying this game even if it has a high price. it has a high price for a reason. Lastly, it is such good quality. It feels like your inside the game but the thing is, your not! Everything is so good however, there are a few bugs that need fixing. For example, I was halfway in decorating one of my clients houses and the game crashed. It has happened multiple times and I think its not fair because I want to enjoy the game with no bugs. Anyways, just needed to get it out there so you can be aware when it happens. Overall, I have loved the game and I give it 9.5 out of ten. :)

tldr.text: Very Positive (94%): players praise the price most and enjoy the relaxing gameplay.
14% of reviews complain about bugs and crashes, the top complaint.

details.text: Complaints about bugs and crashes have dropped in recent reviews, to 4% from 14% across all time.
New players are less enthusiastic, with 61% positive in their first two hours, while players who stick around stay far more positive.
